findings.why: No controlled record covers Viteria Lanzo for HB-620 at any receiving plant or customer. HB-620 ships to the Nordhavn line. That means absence of a release cannot be read as 'not approved', so a person must confirm whether any approval exists. Dora's HB-620 approval was revoked, and Pellice is only planned, pending audit and PPAP.
